images.title: Where does the product land?
images.purpose: Show on three number lines that a product can be greater than both numbers, between them, or less than both.
images.composition: Three horizontal number lines stacked one above the other in the centre of the frame, evenly spaced, with wide white margins; nothing else in the frame except a small legend at the bottom right.
exact_structure: Line 1 (top): a grey #6B7280 number line from 0 to 20 with 0 labelled at its left end; a teal #0072B2 dot at 2.25 labelled 2.25, a teal #0072B2 dot at 8 labelled 8, a reddish purple #CC79A7 dot at 18 labelled 18 (the product, to the right of both teal dots).

Line 2 (middle): a grey #6B7280 number line from 0 to 10 with 0 labelled at its left end; a teal #0072B2 dot at 0.25 labelled 0.25, a reddish purple #CC79A7 dot at 2 labelled 2 (the product, between the teal dots), a teal #0072B2 dot at 8 labelled 8.

Line 3 (bottom): a grey #6B7280 number line from 0 to 1 with 0 labelled at its left end; a reddish purple #CC79A7 dot at 0.2 labelled 0.2 (the product, to the left of both teal dots), a teal #0072B2 dot at 0.25 labelled 0.25, a teal #0072B2 dot at 0.8 labelled 0.8.
On every line the teal dot values are written above the line and the reddish purple product value and the 0 are written below it, so close dots such as 0.2 and 0.25 never have overlapping labels.
Each line has exactly 3 dots: 2 teal (the numbers multiplied) and 1 reddish purple (the product); 9 dots in all.
To the left of each line, its multiplication in dark text: 2.25 × 8, 0.25 × 8, 0.25 × 0.8.
Legend at bottom right: one teal #0072B2 dot with the word numbers, one reddish purple #CC79A7 dot with the word product.
rejection: the product dot on line 1 not to the right of both teal dots, or on line 3 not to the left of both
any dot at a wrong position or with a wrong value (products must be 18, 2 and 0.2)
more or fewer than 3 dots on any line
images.takeaway: A product of decimals can land above both numbers, between them, or below both.
images.description: Three number lines, each with two teal dots for the numbers multiplied and a purple dot for the product: 18 beyond 2.25 and 8, 2 between 0.25 and 8, and 0.2 below 0.25 and 0.8.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video comparing 2.25 × 8, 0.25 × 8 and 0.25 × 0.8.
images.teaching_notes: Ask students to look only at where the purple dot sits relative to the two teal dots on each line, then say what changed between the lines.

image_decisions.why: Seeing where each product lands on a number line makes the three outcomes visible at a glance.
